invocation_ledger.provenance: per-invocation records; RUNNING records are unclosed observations
invocation_ledger.rate_basis: last sealed checkpoint in matching invocation
missing: unobserved tail after a hard process kill; counters are lower bounds for unclosed records
exact rollback-only wall inside an aborted invocation; its total wall may include committed work
invocation_ledger.note: RUNNING means unclosed, not aborted and not proof of a live process. Rate extrapolates a measured window, not a guaranteed wall-clock completion. Shared worker wall includes observed preparation; it is not exclusive GPU compute. Failed-attempt wall is retained, but may include committed work.

cost.note: Phase timers are overlapping rank wall times, not exclusive CPU/GPU compute. scoring_cpu is scorer elapsed, not CPU-core time. Missing legacy attempt/save costs are not fabricated.

limits: Stochastic G8 scores are not original single-ODE deployment scores.
The fixed hard scene list changes training population; do not compare this mean with full-TRAIN or DEV.
A repeated group across four inner updates contributes only one fresh sample group.
Global update count uses all ranks, not rank0 local PG activity.
Window changes also include scene mix; matched fixed-population ODE evaluation determines efficacy.
